City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA

06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.

5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the March 9, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-03-23 Item 08A City Council Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-03-23 Item 08B City Council Warrants
8C.
Appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission for one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2017. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with approval of the City Council, appoint Suzann Lennox to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2017.
2016-03-23 Item 08C Senior Commission Appointment - Redacted
8D.
Three-year Lease for 1867 Mackinnon Avenue property. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
That Council approve the three-year lease for 1867 Mackinnon Avenue
2016-03-23 Item 08D Fire Station Lease Mackinnon Avenue
8E.
California Parks Department, Division of Boating and Waterways Grant Appropriation for $225,000 to support the Coastal Storm Damage Reduction Project. Contact Person: Program Administrator Weldon
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-33 accepting additional grant funds in the amount of $225,000 from the California Parks Department, Division of Boating and Waterways Public Beach Restoration Program, and authorize the City Manager to act as the representative of the City of Encinitas, in consultation with the City Attorney, to negotiate and execute all agreements and amendments necessary to comply with the Division of Boating and Waterways grant requirements; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-34 approving a budget adjustment in the amount of $225,000 for Fiscal Year 2015/16.
2016-03-23 Item 08E Division of Boating and Waterways Grant
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Leo Mullen Sports Park Turf Replacement Project (CP16B). Contact Person: Deputy Director Deane
1) Receive the staff report and determine which project bid alternatives, if any, are to be included in the construction contract for the replacement of turf at Leo Mullen Sports Park; 2) Authorize the Public Works Director to execute a contract, in coordination with the City Attorney, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1, and any necessary amendments, with Byrom-Davey Inc. in the amount of $939,500 plus 10% contingencies to construct the Leo Mullen Sports Park Turf Replacement Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,033,500; and 3) Authorize the Public Works Director to execute a contract amendment (Contract Amendment #1), in substantial form as contained in Attachment 2, and any necessary extensions or further amendments, with Geopacifica Inc. in the amount of $35,000 plus 15% contingencies to provide inspection services for the Leo Mullen Sports Park Turf Replacement Project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $40,250.
2016-03-23 Item 10A Leo Mullen Turf Replacement Project
10B.
Public Hearing: Transnet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2016/17 through 2020/21
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the proposed projects; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-29, approving the five-year Transnet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2016/17 through 2020/21
2016-03-23 Item 10B Transnet Local Street Improvement Program

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
